writtenAlongsideNotOverIt.whyThisFileExists: The lane directory already held a checkpoints.json from the PF-C cohort. Overwriting it would erase that cohort's record. This file is written beside it, matching the precedent build-b-rows.json set for the rows file.

checkpointRule: Return every five completed families, or every two hours, whichever comes first. This lane carries three families and checkpoints per family.
timestampBasis: Each checkpoint time is when this lane finished determining that family's disposition. No family produced a build-status.json, because no family was built.
